SELECT 
  cls,
  COUNT(*) as trips,
  SUM(yt) as total_yt,
  SUM(anglers) as total_anglers,
  ROUND(CAST(SUM(yt) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(SUM(anglers), 0), 3) as yt_per_angler,
  MIN(fish_date_doy) as first_doy,
  MAX(fish_date_doy) as last_doy
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season = 6 AND fish_date_doy >= 53
GROUP BY cls
ORDER BY yt_per_angler DESC;

SELECT 
  fish_date_doy,
  cls,
  COUNT(*) as trips,
  SUM(yt) as total_yt,
  SUM(anglers) as total_anglers,
  ROUND(CAST(SUM(yt) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(SUM(anglers), 0), 3) as yt_per_angler
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season = 6 AND fish_date_doy >= 32 AND fish_date_doy <= 60
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY fish_date_doy DESC, yt_per_angler DESC
LIMIT 80;
